title: Magical Textures 2 -55 Procreate Brushes
author: MissPerfectKaos
description:
Magical Textures 2
The sequel to my best selling brush pack is finally here! l 55 brushes for procreate, all created by me. This is my go to set when I want to create art with lots of texture and interest. The set is filled with brushes for sketching, drawing outlines, shading, adding texture and patterns etc.
Many of the brushes has got custom grain/patterns/shapes, all created by me by drawing repeating patterns or by photographing interesting textures.
***Pls note that this I digital product, the pack includes 55 brushes for procreate. No artwork is included as it is only used as an example of what you could create with these brushes. ***
The brushes are well organized according to category.
